title: 托福官方套题 14 · 口语

tasks.sample: (WA) Start by locating the nearest exit to you.
(WA) Use the extinguisher for small fires.
(WA) Activate the alarm quickly if you happen to smell smoke.
(WA) Proceed to the designated area outside.
(WA) Stay calm, and follow the signs for the evacuation route.
(WA) Assist your colleagues who may need extra help to get safely away from the danger zone.
(WA) The elevators will not be working during a fire drill, so use the stairs instead.

tasks.stem: (Interviewer) Thank you for your participation. I’d like to learn about your daily routine. Can you tell me what a typical day looks like for you?
(Interviewer) Great. If you could design your ideal daily schedule, what would it include? Would it be structured, flexible, or a mix of both?
(Interviewer) Interesting. Some people say how you start your morning shapes your whole day. Do you agree? Why or why not?
(Interviewer) Good points. One final question. Some people believe that having a daily routine can increase productivity and reduce stress. Do you agree or disagree with this viewpoint? Why?
